config.name: Forth Estuary
config._note: Scottish estuary. Bed levels are ASSUMPTIONS (mAOD), no check gauges. Tide from Leith. River flow from SEPA (open data). No open national flood-defence dataset is available for Scotland, so defences are only those in the terrain. Tidal limit position is approximate. Below Kincardine the channel line runs straight through mid-estuary waypoints (OS Open Rivers has no channel line there); widths there count all water across the section.
